description: This Java source file defines the DelegatorEcaHandler class, which implements the EntityEcaHandler interface for handling entity event-condition-action (ECA) rules within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages caching, dispatch context retrieval, and rule evaluation for entities.

classes.name: DelegatorEcaHandler
classes.description: Implements entity ECA rule handling, including cache management, dispatch context retrieval, and rule evaluation within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setDelegator
methods.description: Initializes the handler with a Delegator, sets up asynchronous dispatch context loading, and preloads ECA cache.

methods.name: getDispatchContext
methods.description: Retrieves the dispatch context, waiting for asynchronous loading if necessary.

methods.name: getEntityEventMap
methods.description: Returns the map of event rules for a specific entity.

methods.name: evalRules
methods.description: Evaluates ECA rules for a given entity event, executing associated rules.
